THE ABSOLUTE DARKEST BLACK SKIN ON EARTH blue-black void complexion darker than night sky, mid 50s goddess, BBW bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — most massive full-figure BBW body ever at absolute maximum in every dimension, hips so wide beyond proportion dominating the entire frame, bust so enormous overwhelming gravity, waist deeply snatched despite impossible volume, curtain bangs long straight hair sweeping past the shoulders — full body cream and rose tulipwood carved directly over her own form covering EVERY inch of skin from neck to ankle WITHOUT EXCEPTION, both legs FULLY covered to ankles, NO bare skin below neck ANYWHERE — this is not a garment, not a printed pattern, this is solid carved wood curving to follow her body's true three-dimensional shape, divided into dozens of fitted carved sections whose grain changes direction from one section to the next, each joint standing in a thin raised ridge catching its own soft glint and casting its own small shadow, nothing lying flat. Dense fitted sections — BLAZING cream and rose-pink tulipwood grain across the full torso both legs neck to ankle, VIVID violet ribbons running between the carved sections, polished to a warm satin sheen, completely opaque, NO airbrush NO gradient wash, NO flat printed surface anywhere. She wears a heavy medieval iron neck ring of wide rough-forged wrought iron, closed with a thick iron pin and riveted, with a heavy iron ring at the front, snug around her neck, from which a heavy chain of massive thick black wrought-iron links, each link as thick as a thumb, hangs straight down the front of her body and is joined to that same ring between her feet, so that the neck chain and both ankle chains all meet at that one ring, the long chain hanging in a gentle slack curve. Her wrists wear heavy medieval hinged wrought-iron fetters, wide rough-forged iron bands closed with a thick iron pin and riveted, each with a heavy iron ring, the two wrist fetters joined by one short heavy chain of massive thick black wrought-iron links, each link as thick as a thumb, hanging in a low loop across the front of her hips. Pose: standing full height, facing the camera, her feet a hand's width apart, her arms relaxed at her sides with her hands hanging beside her thighs, the wrist chain hanging across the front of her hips and the long chain hanging down the center of her body to the ring between her feet in view, her chest, shoulders and stomach fully in view.
extreme platform pumps carved from the same tulipwood, extra long nails in matching polished tulipwood.

Background: a medieval stone dungeon torture chamber with rough-cut stone block walls on each side of her, a low vaulted stone ceiling, iron torch sconces with flickering flames on the walls, old iron tools hanging on the stone wall, a damp flagstone floor, dark and moody firelight. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on every surface texture and shadow. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from her feet to the top of her head completely visible. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
